scope: Abstract compost-feedstock custody proposals for deterministic simulation. They are not collection instructions, compost formulas, products, agronomic prescriptions, safety determinations, environmental approvals or legal classifications.

numeric_parameter_contract.validation_rule: Every numeric parameter requires validation_required equal to true.
numeric_parameter_contract.fixture_rule: Exact integers in deterministic_fixture, identity strings, schema versions and declared counts are non-tunable oracle data rather than numeric parameters.

owner_bindings.candidate_behavior: Reference owner events and candidate residue-pool projections only; create no crop, harvest or warehouse truth.
Submit bounded command and paired-delta proposals; never persist authoritative Ecology balances.
Reference soil identity only; create no soil state or nutrient truth.
Require foreign lot, storage, transport and quality-event IDs; create no inventory record.
Reference owner lot and ledger IDs only; do not create quantity, ownership, value, price, cost or fertilizer inventory.
Require owner-native work-shift validation and worker-minute accounting.
Consume explicit decision references only; no proposal grants a right or capability.

state_separation_contract.compost_feedstock: An owner-referenced incoming material custody record before a compost process proposal begins.
state_separation_contract.in_process_batch: COMPOST_BATCH is Ecology-owned decomposition and nutrient-pool state; this dataset only proposes foreign references and event envelopes.
state_separation_contract.finished_candidate_output: A closed candidate material output awaiting owner acceptance and optional Economy lot creation. It is not automatically fertilizer, safe, mature or suitable.
state_separation_contract.fertilizer_inventory: The existing Economy resource ID FERTILIZER remains separate and receives no automatic credit from compost output.
state_separation_contract.soil_nutrient_state: Ecology nutrients_kg and soil nutrient pools remain separate; finished output cannot increase them without a later owner-approved NUTRIENT_RETURN_EVENT.
state_separation_contract.soil_amendment_candidate: AMENDMENT-PROPOSAL-ORGANIC-CARRIER-V1 is only a possible later review target and never an automatic mapping.

feedstock_component_contract.reference_basis: Each deterministic fixture is a closed 100 kilogram wet-mass accounting oracle, not a collection quantity or production formula.
feedstock_component_contract.default_closure_rule: The four component default fractions sum exactly to one for each proposal.
feedstock_component_contract.contamination_rule: Any nonzero unresolved contaminant fixture enters quality hold and cannot enter an in-process batch.
feedstock_component_contract.custody_rule: Every component requires an owner source-event debit and a named receiving-custody credit.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a closed abstract accounting basis and is not a collection or processing amount.
numeric_parameters.risk: The reference basis could be mistaken for operational batch guidance.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Keeps structural residue mass explicit and separate from water and nutrient custody.
numeric_parameters.risk: No crop-specific residue composition is established.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Tracks feedstock water as physical mass and as a parallel water-custody subledger.
numeric_parameters.risk: The value is not a moisture specification or handling recommendation.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Preserves an abstract nutrient subset without inferring chemistry or availability.
numeric_parameters.risk: The proxy cannot support an agronomic or fertilizer claim.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Forces every nonzero unresolved contaminant fixture into quality hold.
numeric_parameters.risk: Zero is a simulation gate and not a purity or safety threshold.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a common deterministic accounting basis and is not a collection amount.
numeric_parameters.risk: The basis could be misread as a processing recommendation.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Keeps structural vegetable residue separate from water and nutrient subsets.
numeric_parameters.risk: No species, cultivar or waste-stream composition is represented.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Creates a closed water-custody subset for the abstract wet residue fixture.
numeric_parameters.risk: Not a real moisture measurement or storage instruction.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Keeps abstract nutrient mass visible without claiming availability.
numeric_parameters.risk: The proxy cannot establish fertilizer value or crop response.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Requires quality hold for any nonzero unresolved contamination.
numeric_parameters.risk: This is not a regulatory or toxicological limit.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides an abstract closed accounting basis and is not a harvest amount.
numeric_parameters.risk: Could be misconstrued as authorization to remove forest biomass.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Separates dead structural biomass from contained water and nutrients.
numeric_parameters.risk: Forest material properties vary and living biomass remains excluded.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Tracks contained water as a named subset of wet mass.
numeric_parameters.risk: Not a dryness, storage or combustion specification.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Preserves a bounded nutrient subset through owner review.
numeric_parameters.risk: No nutrient availability or soil benefit is established.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Blocks nonzero unresolved contamination from entering a batch.
numeric_parameters.risk: Zero is not evidence of safety or material purity.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Provides a closed accounting basis for an abstract owner-referenced waste lot.
numeric_parameters.risk: The fixture is not collection, sorting or processing guidance.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Separates structural organic material from water and nutrient subsets.
numeric_parameters.risk: Actual waste streams are heterogeneous and source mapping is underspecified.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Keeps contained water explicit in the wet-mass fixture.
numeric_parameters.risk: Not a moisture or storage specification.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Tracks a low-resolution nutrient subset without assigning fertilizer value.
numeric_parameters.risk: No composition, maturity or agronomic outcome can be inferred.

numeric_parameters.rationale: Requires any nonzero unresolved contaminant mass to remain on hold.
numeric_parameters.risk: The gate is not a safety, food-waste or legal acceptance criterion.
